instruction: An abstract owl sculpture built from bold flat polygonal facets — angular triangulated body, big geometric eyes and a sharp faceted beak, perched upright. Matte stone-grey planes with crisp faceted shading.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE faceted geometric owl in a abstract low-poly polygonal sculpture style. An abstract owl sculpture built from bold flat polygonal facets — angular triangulated body, big geometric eyes and a sharp faceted beak, perched upright. Matte stone-grey planes with crisp faceted shading. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
